title: I built an Android game using AI-generated assets — Aurora Wings 🐦❄️
author: Big_Inevitable8354
selftext:
I recently built and released my first Android game, Aurora Wings.

I used AI during development, especially for creating the game's visual assets, while building the game itself with **HTML/CSS/JavaScript and PixiJS.**

One thing I learned is that getting consistent assets and making them work together in an actual game takes much more work than simply generating individual images.

The game has **10+ Adventure effects** and a **global leaderboard 🌎🏆**

**Video is just one of the Mode in 🎮 game 🎯** 

If you're intrested in checking it out, it's available on

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mushroomstudios.aurorawings

replies.author: Big_Inevitable8354
replies.body: It’s a simple game, but I had fun building it and experimenting with the Adventure mode

comments.author: ScaredFlamingo6807
comments.body: I think it’s cool. It’s a pretty overdone format/genre but in either case, I encourage experimentation and having fun with it. Good job
